en.headline: CityU team uses green-research grant to reuse retired EV batteries
en.dek: Professor Chung Shu-hung's group received HK$6.7 million from the Low Carbon Green Research Fund to develop a smart power conditioner for second-life electric-vehicle batteries.
body: A City University of Hong Kong electrical-engineering team led by Professor Chung Shu-hung has used a HK$6.7 million grant from the Environment and Ecology Bureau's Low Carbon Green Research Fund to develop a smart power conditioner that lets retired electric-vehicle batteries supply ordinary electricity loads.

Chung said retired packs typically retain about 70 to 80 percent of their capacity but can no longer deliver the short, high-power bursts a car needs. The team has built a framework covering collection, screening, testing and system integration, and has applied the batteries in solar storage. Possible uses include powering construction sites in place of diesel generators. He estimated that about 20,000 electric vehicles in Hong Kong will be retired by 2030; reusing batteries from 10,000 of them could supply about 520,000 kilowatt-hours a year, enough to cover three minutes of citywide demand, at 30 to 40 percent of the cost of new batteries.

Chung said safety has to be managed because ageing cells can overcharge, and that the weight of the packs makes local processing preferable. The university is transferring the technology and talking to industry about commercial use. Climate Change Commissioner Yeung Sau-kuen said the fund has received HK$400 million in total, approved 39 projects costing about HK$171 million, and completed 24 of them; she said there was no urgent need for a further injection.

zh.headline: 城大獲綠色科研基金研退役電動車電池再利用
zh.dek: 電機工程學系鍾樹鴻教授團隊獲環境及生態局低碳綠色科研基金撥款六百七十萬元，研發智能功率調節器，讓退役電動車電池作一般供電。
body: 香港城市大學電機工程學系教授鍾樹鴻帶領的團隊，獲環境及生態局轄下低碳綠色科研基金撥款六百七十萬元，研發智能功率調節器，讓退役電動車電池剩餘電量用於一般電力負載。
鍾樹鴻表示，退役電池通常仍有約七至八成容量，只是未能在短時間輸出汽車所需的高功率，可用於建築地盤取代柴油發電機，或接入太陽能儲能系統。團隊已建立收集、篩選、測試及系統集成的框架。他預計至二零三零年本港約有兩萬輛電動車退役；若重用當中一萬輛的電池，每年約可提供五十二萬度電，相當於全港用電三分鐘，成本約為新電池的三至四成。
他指舊電池特性已變，或出現過度充電，須處理安全問題；電池沉重，較適宜在港處理。大學正進行技術轉移，並與業界商討合作。環境及生態局氣候變化專員楊秀權表示，基金累計獲注資四億元，至今批出三十九個項目、涉款約一億七千一百萬元，其中二十四個已完成，目前無迫切需要再注資。
